Thank you to all that serve our country. Show less Read more Like 45 Dislike Reply 2 replies Hide replies 2 replies @I_AM_GENO_TWO 11 months ago (edited) This brings back so many memories. I am a former orbital analyst and used to do most of this same work when it was still Air Force Space Command. I was assigned to the 1st Command and Control Squadron or 1CACS and part of our responsibilities was the space catalog and tasking the space surveillance network to capture OBS (observation) positional data on objects orbiting in space, plus so much more. During this time, I worked in the Space Control Center (SCC) and Space Analysis Center (SAC) located inside Cheyenne Mountain Air Station.
